WHAT_THIS_IS: Capture attempts that were ended before they executed, and why. A cancelled run keeps its GitHub metadata, but GitHub records only 'cancelled' -- it cannot record that the code was superseded. This file is that record.

RUNS.TERMINAL_CONFIRMED_HOW: re-read of the run after the 202 acknowledgement; an acknowledgement alone was treated as insufficient
RUNS.WHY_IT_COULD_NOT_BE_REPAIRED_IN_PLACE: a workflow_dispatch run resolves its workflow file at dispatch time, so the GATE 3 correction on the branch could never reach a run already pinned to ced8720. It would have executed the old curl 'status=in_progress' gate.

RUNS.NOT_TOUCHED: run85 and every other collector; no other run was cancelled, displaced, modified or rescheduled
